verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair question for a workflow-automation platform with its own API, so the axis applies. The pack only shows a bare 'n8n API' docs title, a list of stored third-party integration credentials, and general role-based access for users. None of these documents issuing scoped or least-privilege API keys or tokens for an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
